subject: Condensed-term credit and one-time packaging request — VP/CFO signoff needed
messages:
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: BrightRoot — request for condensed 6-month term + one-time onboarding credit

Hey Mina / Marissa,

Quick summary from my call with BrightRoot (CEO + procurement): they want to commit to a 6-month pilot (target start 9/7) but are pushing for a one-time onboarding credit of $45k to cover engineering integration + POC usage. Their projected monthly run-rate would be ~$32k if we keep baseline tokens, and they sign a 12-month after-pilot commitment we can get to their target ARR.

Their asks: 
- One-time credit: $45,000 (applied in month 1)
- Pilot term: 6 months, with option to convert to 12 months at current pricing tier
- Limited scope: hosted API only, no private deployment for pilot

I attached the SOW draft and a quick pricing sheet. Based on the current pricing guardrails, this is beyond standard CS playbook (our max one-off credit for pilot is $25k without exec signoff).

Can we escalate for VP/CFO approval? If you want, I'll draft a short memo. Need decision by EOD 8/29 (their board funding review is 9/1).

- Rafa
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BrightRoot_SOW_draft_v3.pdf, pricing_memo_condensed_term.xlsx

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-27T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightRoot — request for condensed 6-month term + one-time onboarding credit

Marissa / Rafa — thanks for the context. I'm looping Markus (VP Sales) because this deviates from our standard pilot credit cap. I agree on the strategic fit: BrightRoot is in the healthcare vertical and could be a high-touch enterprise case with strong expansion potential.

Requested next steps: 
1) Rafa — please confirm that the $45k credit is strictly one-time (no ongoing discount baked into MRR) and that the pilot includes defined success metrics (list attached in SOW).
2) Marissa / Markus — if you think this is strategically worthwhile, I will prepare the exception memo for VP/CFO signoff with recommended mitigation (clawback if they don't convert to 12 months, billing milestones tied to deliverables).

I'll draft the memo and attach the pricing delta calculation.

-Mina
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-28T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Exception memo: BrightRoot one-time onboarding credit (recommendation)

Markus / Laura — attaching the exception memo and pricing worksheet for the BrightRoot request. TL;DR recommendation below; full rationale in the memo.

Recommendation (decision requested): Approve a one-time onboarding credit of $40,000 (reduced from the requested $45k) applied at invoice month 1, contingent on: 
- Signed SOW + DocuSign envelope (link below) before 9/3/2026
- Execution of a 12-month committed term within 90 days of pilot start OR a clawback of 50% of the credit applied against the final pilot invoice
- Pilot limited to hosted API with a usage cap of 1.2M tokens/month unless pre-approved by Sales Ops

Business rationale: 
- Expected ARR if converted: $384k/year at projected consumption (IRR > 3x over 12 months)
- Strategic vertical (healthcare) with potential regulatory lead-gen for other accounts
- Competitive risk: competitor X is offering a deeper credit but requires a longer revenue share — we preserve unit economics with the clawback

Attachments included: pricing_memo_condensed_term.xlsx, BrightRoot_SOW_draft_v3.pdf
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/12345ABC

Please reply with signoff or any redlines. I can update the memo to reflect any change in the clawback percentage.

-Mina
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_memo_condensed_term.xlsx, BrightRoot_SOW_draft_v3.pdf

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-28T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exception memo: BrightRoot one-time onboarding credit (recommendation)

Thanks Mina — good write-up. I support a 1) reduced credit amount and 2) clawback tied to conversion. Two quick clarifying Qs before I sign: 
- Can Sales Ops add a milestone that 50% of the credit is released only after BrightRoot completes integration testing (so we don't pay the full credit up-front)?
- Is the 1.2M tokens/month cap above expected pilot usage or equal to target consumption? If it's below target we'd need to change the cap or adjust pricing to avoid frequent exceptions.

If Laura is comfortable with the finance mitigation (clawback + milestone), I'm prepared to sign off and loop in Legal for a short amendment to the SOW.

-Markus
VP Sales
Redwood Inference

> On Thu, Aug 28, 2026 at 8:45 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Attached the memo and pricing worksheet for review.

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-29T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exception memo: BrightRoot one-time onboarding credit (recommendation)

Markus / Mina — I reviewed the numbers and the mitigation plan. Finance will approve the one-time credit at $40,000 with the following conditions (please treat as final unless Legal or Sales propose material changes):

1) Credit structure: 50% of the credit ($20,000) applied after invoice month 1, remaining 50% held in reserve and only released upon successful completion of integration testing and signed 12-month conversion amendment (or returned via clawback if conversion not executed within 90 days).
2) Accounting: credit recognized as contra-revenue; we will need the signed amendment lodged before month-end close for revenue forecasting.
3) Legal: include explicit clawback terms and milestone definitions in SOW amendment. Finance will not permit retroactive application once month close is complete.

I will sign the internal approval. Rafa — please ensure the DocuSign envelope is completed by BrightRoot and route the executed SOW to finance@redwood.com (attach the signature_block.png to the final package).

Approval: Laura Bennett, VP Finance (signed)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: signature_block.png

> On Thu, Aug 28, 2026 at 12:18 PM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Two quick clarifying Qs before I sign: milestone release + token cap details.
